chip.summary: A few tips before you continue

modal.title: Check your photo
modal.subtitle: These issues will likely hurt the result. Retake for a better photo, or use this one anyway.

warnings.severeBlur: Photo is very blurry — steady your phone and try again.
warnings.mildBlur: Photo looks a bit soft — a sharper shot will look better.
warnings.severeDark: Photo is too dark to recover — move to better light.
warnings.severeBright: Photo is overexposed — too much light on the dish.
warnings.tooSmall: Photo resolution is too small for good output.
warnings.lowRes: Photo resolution is low — output quality may suffer.
warnings.oddAspect: Unusual photo shape — is this a food photo or a screenshot?
